task.title: Check Out a Branch
task.shortdesc: Use the Git History view to switch to an existing branch or create a new branch from a selected commit.

context.p: Use the Checkout action in the Git History view to switch to an existing branch that points to a selected commit or to create a new branch from that commit.

step.cmd: Open the Git History view and select the commit that you want to use as the checkout target.
Right-click the commit and choose Checkout.
If one or more local branches already point to the selected commit, choose Switch to existing local branch and select the branch that you want to check out.
If you want to create a new branch from the selected commit, choose Create a new branch and enter or confirm the branch name.
If the selected commit is associated with a remote branch, optionally select the remote branch to track.
Click OK to complete the checkout.

result.p: The selected branch is checked out, or a new branch is created from the selected commit and checked out.

postreq.p: If uncommitted changes are present, the Git Client can prompt you to stash the changes, move them to the checked-out branch, or cancel the operation.
When the choice is unambiguous, double-clicking a commit or a branch label in the Git History view can switch directly to the matching branch without opening the dialog.
